# Design tokens

Every value in `@surgijs/ui/themes.css` comes from the token files in `packages/ui/tokens`, and the same files produce the Figma token sets in `packages/ui/tokens/figma`. A Figma variable takes the token path as its name, so `color/primary-hover` is `--s-color-primary-hover` in CSS.

Light values apply by default. Dark values apply under `data-theme="dark"` or, without a `data-theme` on the root, when the OS prefers dark.

## Typography

| Token | Value | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--s-font-family` | `system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif` | Text in components. |
| `--s-font-size-sm` | `0.875rem` | Small text: the `sm` size of components. |
| `--s-font-size-md` | `1rem` | Default text size of components. |
| `--s-font-size-lg` | `1.125rem` | Large text: the `lg` size of components. |
| `--s-font-weight-medium` | `500` | Button labels. |

## Corners

| Token | Value | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--s-radius-sm` | `4px` | Small corners. |
| `--s-radius-md` | `6px` | Default corners of components. |
| `--s-radius-lg` | `8px` | Large corners. |
| `--s-radius-full` | `999px` | Pill-shaped corners. |

## Motion

| Token | Value | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--s-duration-fast` | `120ms` | Hover and press transitions. |
